en: You fell. Returning to the last checkpoint…
zh_TW: 你倒下了。回到上一個檢查點……

en: Cost: the last talk with Father beneath the arch
zh_TW: 代價：與父親最後一次在石拱下交談的記憶

en: The Undertaker raises the iron frame — toward the cart!
zh_TW: 送葬者舉起了鐵架——對準車隊！

en: The arch takes the frame. It holds.
zh_TW: 鐵架砸在石拱上。石拱撐住了。

en: Sheila's sword catches fire — she cuts the frame in two.
zh_TW: 席菈的劍燒了起來——她把鐵架斬成兩截。
